newsitem.title: FRANCE: MOTOR RACING-LE MANS 24-HOURS PLACINGS AFTER 17 HOURS.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-LE MANS 24-HOURS PLACINGS AFTER 17 HOURS.

text.p: Leading placings in the Le Mans 24 Hours race after 17 hours on Sunday:
1. Yannick Dalmas (France)/Ralf Kelleners (Germany)/Emmanuel Collard (France), Porsche 911 GT1, 253 laps
2. Michele Alboreto (Italy)/Stefan Johansson (Sweden)/Tom Kristensen (Denmark), TWR Porsche-Joest, one lap behind
3. Jean-Marc Gounon (France)/Pierre-Henri Raphanel (France)/Anders Olofsson (Sweden), McLaren BMW F1GTR, one lap
4. Peter Kox (Netherlands)/Roberto Ravaglia (Italy)/Eric Helary (France), McLaren BMW F1GTR, three
5. Andrew Scott (Britain)/Ray Bell (Britain)/Masanori Sekiya (Japan), McLaren BMW F1GTR, four
6. Pedro Lamy (Portugal)/Patrice Goueslard (France)/Armin Hahne (Germany), Porsche 911 GT1, eight
7. JJ Lehto (Finland)/Steve Soper (Britain)/Nelson Piquet (Brazil), McLaren BMW F1GTR, 15
8. Didier Cottaz (France)/Jerome Policand (France)/Marc Goosens (Belgium), Courage C41, 22
9. Giampiero Moretti (Italy)/Didier Theys (Belgium) /Massimiliano Papis (Italy), Ferrari 333 SP
10. Pierluigi Martini (Italy)/Christian Pescatori (Italy) /Antonio Hermann (Brazil), Porsche 911 GT1 both 29.
